title: MAGIC ENGLISH BEGINNER — WORLD 1: MY FIRST ENGLISH
description: A high-density beginner foundation covering alphabet, phonics, numbers, colors, classroom English, greetings, family, body, home, daily actions, feelings, food, animals, weather and first real-life conversations.

missions.title: Meet the Alphabet
listening: Identify the letter you hear.
Choose the beginning letter of a word.

missions.title: Phonics Power
speaking: Tell the first sound of each word.
listening: Match sounds to pictures.
Find two words with the same beginning sound.

missions.title: Numbers 0–20
listening: Identify numbers you hear.
Listen and count objects.

missions.title: Colors Everywhere
listening: Listen and find the correct color.
Follow two-step color instructions.

missions.title: My Classroom
speaking: Say: Can I have a pencil, please?
listening: Follow classroom commands.
Find the object named in a short dialogue.

missions.title: Hello! My Name Is...
listening: Identify greetings.
Listen to a two-person introduction and answer questions.

missions.title: My Family
speaking: Answer: Who is he? Who is she?
listening: Identify family members in a dialogue.
Listen and build a simple family picture.

missions.title: My Body
listening: Follow body-part instructions.
Identify body parts in a song or short dialogue.

missions.title: My Home
listening: Listen to a room description.
Find objects using location clues.
grammar: The book is on the table.
The bag is under the chair.
The lamp is in the room.

missions.title: First Conversation
listening: Understand a short self-introduction.
Identify name, age, family and favorite color.
missions.challenge: Complete a guided 60-second English introduction using only English prompts.

missions.title: Numbers 21–100
listening: Identify two-digit numbers.
Listen and write the number you hear.
missions.challenge: Hear ten numbers and repeat them accurately.

missions.title: Shapes and Patterns
speaking: Describe a shape by size and color.
listening: Follow shape-drawing instructions.
Find the shape described in a short audio prompt.

missions.title: Feelings and Emotions
speaking: Ask a friend how they feel.
listening: Identify feelings from voices and sentences.
Listen to a short child-friendly conversation about feelings.

missions.title: Action Time
listening: Follow one-step and two-step commands.
Identify the action in a short sentence.

missions.title: Food and Drinks
speaking: Ask: Can I have some water, please?
listening: Identify foods in a simple order.
Listen for likes and dislikes.
grammar: Can I have some water, please?

missions.title: Animals and Nature
listening: Identify animals from sounds or descriptions.
Listen to a mini nature story.

missions.title: Weather and Seasons
listening: Identify weather words.
Listen to a simple weather report.

missions.title: My Day
speaking: Say three things you do every day.
listening: Put routine events in order.
Identify morning, afternoon and evening activities.
grammar: I wake up in the morning.

missions.title: Real-Life English: At the Shop
listening: Understand a simple purchase dialogue.
Identify item, quantity and price.

missions.title: WORLD 1 MASTER QUEST
speaking: Ask and answer three real-life questions.
listening: Understand a 45–60 second beginner dialogue.
Identify key details: name, age, family, likes, school and weather.
reading: Read a short 80–100 word beginner story and answer who, what and where questions.
missions.challenge: Complete a multi-skill English mission using alphabet, numbers, vocabulary, listening, speaking, reading and writing without translating every sentence.

world_review.mastery: Learner can understand and produce very short everyday English about self, family, school, home, food, feelings, animals, weather and simple shopping.
